ERP & Data Integration

Your Odoo data, ready for enterprise analytics

NexoIQ combines Odoo know-how with Azure and Databricks experience to bring ERP data into a governed lakehouse — and on to Power BI.

Discuss your project

A typical scenario

Odoo runs the operation. Reporting runs on spreadsheets.

A company uses Odoo for sales, purchasing and inventory management. Management needs centralised analytics — margins, stock turnover, supplier performance — often combined with data from other systems.

Standard Odoo reports do not cover cross-company or cross-system questions, and manual exports to spreadsheets are slow and error-prone.

Example solution architecture

From Odoo to Power BI in six steps

This is an example architecture that illustrates our approach. It does not describe a specific client implementation; every design is adapted to your environment, data volumes and security requirements.

  1. 01

    Odoo data source analysis

    Identify the models, fields and business rules behind each KPI — sales orders, stock moves, purchase lines and invoices.

  2. 02

    Data extraction architecture

    Choose the extraction method: the Odoo external API, or a read-only database replica where direct access is available (typically on-premise). Incremental loads based on change timestamps.

  3. 03

    Azure Data Pipelines

    Scheduled, monitored pipelines land raw Odoo data in Azure storage, with logging and retry handling.

  4. 04

    Databricks Lakehouse

    Bronze, silver and gold layers on Delta Lake, governed with Unity Catalog.

  5. 05

    Data transformation & modeling

    Cleansing, currency and multi-company handling, and a dimensional model with one definition per KPI.

  6. 06

    Power BI reporting integration

    Semantic models and dashboards on the gold layer, refreshed automatically.

Transparency

What is proven, and what is designed per project

Demonstrated capabilities

  • Odoo 18 configuration and custom module development
  • Azure Databricks lakehouses with Delta Lake and Unity Catalog
  • Migration of legacy ETL to Databricks with CI/CD in Azure DevOps
  • Power BI semantic models on ERP and CRM data
  • SAP data made available in Databricks without copying

Designed for your project

  • The Odoo extraction method and load frequency
  • Which Odoo modules and companies are in scope
  • Security, access and data residency requirements
  • KPI definitions and the dashboard set
  • Hosting choices and cloud cost budget

Deliverables

What you receive

  • Architecture document and data flow diagram
  • Source-to-target mapping for the in-scope Odoo models
  • Pipelines and lakehouse tables in your own Azure tenant
  • Power BI data model and initial dashboards
  • Handover documentation and a walkthrough for your team
